crossRefs.note: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse…

translations.web: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
translations.bsb: Poverty and shame come to him who ignores discipline, but whoever heeds correction is honored.
translations.kjv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
translations.asv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth correction; But he that regardeth reproof shall be honored.
